resources.string: Panel preparation or opening failed. Check the network and available storage, then retry or reinstall the panel. Restart the proxy after installation.
Script download or processing failed. Check the URL, network and JavaScript content. The previous script is retained.
Use the local zashboard panel in the system browser to manage the current mihomo session.

Enable to download and verify an official release, or reuse the installed version. Interrupted requests are retried within a time limit. Missing or damaged files can be repaired offline using the verified archive. Reinstall downloads the selected version again; restart the proxy to use it.

Only the current local VPN session can be opened. Do not share or bookmark its full URL, which contains a temporary secret. Use a modern browser and reopen from Jeemi after restarting. Panel changes are not saved to Jeemi. Failed or cancelled preparation preserves the previous installation; leaving Home or entering the background cancels unfinished downloads.
Save local JavaScript or download source from an HTTP(S) URL into the private library.

Paste a script URL into the source editor and save to download it. The script card refresh button downloads it again. Editing the same source, composing candidates and starting the proxy use cached source. Unsaved URLs can be tested. Export includes the source URL and cached code; import uses packaged code offline.

Scripts must define synchronous main(config), stay within 256 KiB and finish in two seconds, without file or network APIs. Downloads time out after 30 seconds. Cancellation, errors, invalid content and revision conflicts preserve the old script. Saving validates all affected subscriptions and running sessions require a restart. Source URLs may contain credentials; keep exports private. Leaving the page or entering the background cancels downloads; closing help retains the draft.
Browse nested selectors using the same two-line cards as proxy nodes, with the final egress node and its latency.

The first line shows the group name; the second shows its type and current final node latency. A valid icon image appears before the name at the same font size; missing or failed images leave only the original name. Tap the card to select it in the current manual selector. Tap its latency badge only to browse the child group, without testing or changing selection. Return paths appear only inside a child group; referenced hidden groups remain accessible. Headers show only the final node name; long-press to read its full name.

Latency comes only from the final node in the matching live session. Without a measurement, while stopped or pending changes, or without a fixed egress, the badge shows “—” and remains available for browsing. Automatic members cannot be manually pinned; balancing has no fixed egress. Search matches real nodes and batch tests use the same results. Invalid or cyclic references stop navigation.
Panel installed. Restart the proxy to apply.
